title: Tulsa Toddler First Steps, Plaid Blanket - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: OCT 20 1944 A "XENIX" PRINT ROCHESTER PHOTO SUPPLY CO. TULSA
description: A toddler balances carefully while taking steps outdoors on a sunny autumn day. The child wears a long-sleeved play shirt, shorts, and early walking shoes with socks, casting a strong shadow on the ground. A patterned plaid blanket serves as a makeshift outdoor backdrop. Developed by Rochester Photo Supply Co. in Tulsa during the World War II era, the snapshot captures an intimate milestone of wartime home-front family life.
